rm.title: Log a call
rm.sub: After you speak to a lead
rm.q: How do I log a call after speaking to a lead?
rm.a:
Fill the **Call Disposition Form** after every call.
1. Call the lead by clicking their phone number.
2. Open the lead's **Tasks** tab (or open the task from a Smart Views tab or your Dashboard).
3. Open the task and click **Mark as Complete**. The form opens as a side panel.
[screenshot: mark_complete]
4. Pick **Cal Status** (Connect or Non Connect), then **Disposition**, then **Sub Disposition**.
5. Callback needed? Set **Follow-up Date & Time**.
6. Add **Remarks**, then click **Save** (bottom right). The task is marked complete.
[screenshot: dispo_followup]
(Manual: Section 5)

rm.title: Set a follow-up
rm.sub: So the lead comes back to you
rm.q: How do I set a follow-up?
rm.a:
Set **Follow-up Date & Time** on the Call Disposition Form. It creates your next task at that time, puts the lead back in **Today Follow Up Leads**, and notifies you when it's due.
1. After the call, open the task and click **Mark as Complete**.
2. Fill **Cal Status**, **Disposition** and **Sub Disposition**. The follow-up field appears after these.
3. Pick the date (DD/MM/YYYY), then the hour, minute (00 / 15 / 30 / 45) and AM/PM, and click **Ok**.
4. Click **Save**.
[screenshot: dispo_followup]
No follow-up date means the lead won't come back to you on its own.
(Manual: Section 5)

rm.title: Pick a disposition
rm.q: Which Call Status, Disposition and Sub Disposition should I choose?
rm.a:
Choose in this order: **Cal Status** → **Disposition** → the closest **Sub Disposition**.
- **Connect:** Interested, Poor Network, Not Interested, Language Barrier, Document Issue.
- **Non Connect:** No Contact.
- Sub Dispositions ending in **- Retry** keep the lead open so you try again.
- Sub Dispositions ending in **- Invalid lead** close the lead out. Use them only when you're sure the number or lead isn't valid.
If the customer wants a callback (for example **Call Back** or **Customer to do on his own - Follow Up**), also set a **Follow-up Date & Time**.
Open the **Manual** and see Section 7 for every option.
(Manual: Section 7)

rm.title: Drop-off leads
rm.sub: What they are, what to do
rm.q: What is a Drop Off Lead?
rm.a:
A Drop Off Lead reached **Lead Verified** but hasn't completed KYC within 30 minutes. The customer started and stalled, so your call is what gets them moving again.
1. Open **Smart Views** → **Drop Off Leads**. Work this tab first every day, with Today Follow Up Leads.
2. Open the lead and check **Drop Off Lead Flag** in Opportunity Details. It names the stage where the lead stalled, for example KYC Drop Off.
3. Call the customer and help them past that stage.
4. Log the call, and set a follow-up if needed.
[screenshot: lead_detail]
You also get a **Drop Off Stage Notify** alert on mobile and web when one of your leads stalls.
(Manual: Sections 3, 4 and 6)

rm.title: Start my day
rm.q: What should I do first every day?
rm.a:
Clear overdue work first, then follow-ups and drop-offs, then new leads.
1. Log in and open your **Dashboard** (Home icon). Note **Overdue Tasks Count** and **Follow Up Leads**.
2. Clear overdue tasks (Overdue Tasks Count tile, or each lead's **Tasks** tab).
3. Work **Today Follow Up Leads** and **Drop Off Leads** in Smart Views.
4. For each lead: read **Opportunity Details** and **Activity History**, call, then **Mark as Complete** and log the call.
5. Not resolved? Set a **Follow-up Date & Time**.
6. Then work **New Leads**, then **Application Submitted** and **Esign Leads**.
7. At the end of the day, re-check **Completed Tasks Count** and **Conversion Percentage** on the Dashboard.
[screenshot: dashboard]
(Manual: Section 9)

rm.title: My dashboard
rm.q: What do the tiles on my Dashboard mean?
rm.a:
Your **User Dashboard** (Home icon) shows only your numbers. Use **Filter** (top right) to set the period.
- **Row 1, leads:** Total Leads, Open Leads, Converted Leads (Account Opened), Conversion Percentage, Conversion TAT (average days and hours to convert), Lost Leads.
- **Row 2, tasks:** Total, Pending (not yet due), **Overdue** (clear these first), Completed, and Follow Up Leads (leads with a follow-up date set).
- **Calls:** Total and Connected Calls, Unique Leads Connected, Average Call Duration, Outbound and Inbound calls (and how many were answered).
- **Charts:** Opportunity Trend Analysis, Stage Wise Data Analysis (funnel), Users Phone Call Analysis, Funnel Stage TAT Analysis (time spent in each stage).
[screenshot: dashboard]
(Manual: Section 8)

rm.title: Lead stages
rm.q: What do the onboarding stages mean?
rm.a:
Every lead moves forward through these stages, in order:
1. **Lead Creation:** email, phone and basic details captured.
2. **Lead Verified:** phone number OTP verified (New Leads tab).
3. **KYC:** PAN / Aadhaar captured via DigiLocker.
4. **Customer Demographic & FATCA:** personal details being verified.
5. **Bank Details & Verification:** bank added; penny-drop or cheque verification.
6. **Trading Preference & Segment Selection:** Cash / F&O / Commodity chosen.
7. **Account Preferences:** brokerage plan selected.
8. **e-Sign (Selfie, Sign, KRA, AOF)** (Esign Leads tab).
9. **Application Submitted** (Application Submitted tab).
10. **Account Opened / First Trade:** Won.
Lost stages: **Closed - Lost** (closed automatically after no progress) and **Decided not to buy**.
(Manual: Section 6)

rm.title: Login help
rm.a:
Log in with the email and password your Admin or Team Lead gave you.
1. Open **app.leadsquared.com**.
2. On **Welcome to LeadSquared**, enter your email and click **Continue**.
[screenshot: login_email]
3. On **Glad to see you!**, check the email (pencil icon to fix it), enter your **Password** and click **Continue**.
4. Forgot it? Click **Forgot Password?** under the button.
After login you land on **Manage Contacts**. If your account uses OTP login, keep the phone or email that receives the OTP handy.
(Manual: Section 2)

admin.title: Create a user
admin.q: How do I create a new Sales User?
admin.a:
Go to **Settings → Users and Permissions → Users**.
1. Click **Create** (blue, top right of the list).
2. In **Basic Details**, fill First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Phone (Mobile), User Type, Sales Role, Reporting to, Team and **Employee Code** (required).
3. Check **Sales Role**: it starts as Administrator. RMs need **Sales User**.
4. Click **Create User**, or **Create and Add New** to add another.
[screenshot: create_user]
(Manual: Section 10.2)

admin.title: Edit a user
admin.q: How do I edit a user?
admin.a:
Go to **Settings → Users and Permissions → Users**.
1. Open the user from the Users list. The **Edit user** window shows their name, email, phone and role.
2. Pick a tab: Details, Work Details, Location Details, Manage Permissions, Other Details or Report Subscriptions.
3. Click **Edit** (top right of the tab) to make changes. **×** closes the window.
[screenshot: edit_user]
(Manual: Section 10.2)

admin.title: Permissions
admin.q: What can Sales Users do, and how do I change it?
admin.a:
Go to **Settings → Users and Permissions → Permission Templates → Sales User Permissions**.
- **Leads:** view, create, import.
- **Activities:** view, import; create and edit **only Call Disposition**.
- **Tasks:** view; create and mark complete **only Meeting** tasks.
- **Opportunity:** view, create.
- Restricted areas: Marketing, Workflow, Custom Apps.
To change a partly allowed (yellow) permission:
1. Click **Configure** under the yellow circle.
2. Click **Restrict** to block an item, or **×** on a blocked item to allow it again.
3. Click **Save**.
[screenshot: perm_grid]
(Manual: Section 10.4)

admin.title: Dropdown options
admin.q: How do I change a dropdown field's options?
admin.a:
Go to **Settings → Opportunities → Opportunity Types**, open the Opportunity type's field list, and use the field's **gear**.
1. Click the gear → **Enter Dropdown Options**.
2. Choose **Is Dependent Field?** Yes or No.
3. Type the options, one per line. The top option is the default. Or use **Click here to import a CSV file of options**.
4. Tick **Allow Auto Update** or **Is Multi-Select Dropdown?** if needed.
5. Click **Save**.
[screenshot: dropdown_options]
(Manual: Sections 10.6 and 10.7)

admin.title: Smart View tabs
admin.q: How do I edit the Smart View tabs?
admin.a:
Go to **Settings → Opportunities → Smart Views**. **INCRED SMART VIEW** is assigned to Mumbai Team and Delhi Team.
1. Open **INCRED SMART VIEW** for editing (its options are under the **gear** in Actions).
2. Click a tab (or its **Details** link) to edit it: Leads, New Leads, Today Follow Up Leads, Drop Off Leads, Esign Leads, Application Submitted Leads.
3. Each tab has its filters, **Manage Filters**, and **Configure** in the Actions column.
4. Click **Save**.
[screenshot: sv_edit]
(Manual: Section 10.10)

admin.title: Lead routing
admin.q: How are leads assigned to teams?
admin.a:
Two automations decide who owns a lead.
- **Opp create:** every new opportunity is first assigned to a set default user.
- **Stage Flow:** when a lead reaches **Lead Verified** it's distributed to **Mumbai Team** users; at **Application Submitted** it's distributed to **Delhi Team** users. The owner then gets a nudge.
- Working hours are 09:00–17:00. Leads arriving outside these hours wait until **10:00 AM** before they're assigned.
- The team for each branch is set by the Admin in each **Distribute Opportunity** step's user properties.
[screenshot: auto_stage_flow]
(Manual: Section 10.12)

admin.title: Duplicate leads
admin.a:
Go to **Settings → Opportunities → Duplicate Detection**. It's enabled for Opportunity.
Rule 1 treats a new opportunity as a duplicate when **all** of these match:
1. Phone contains data.
2. The contact already has an Opportunity with Status **Open**.
3. The contact has an Opportunity with the **same Product**.
If a rule matches, no new opportunity is created. A **Duplicate Detected** activity is added to the existing one (the oldest, if there are several). Rule changes take effect after 15 minutes.
[screenshot: dup_detect]
(Manual: Section 10.9)

admin.title: Stages and statuses
admin.q: How do I change the stages under each status?
admin.a:
Use the **Status Configuration** window for the Opportunity type.
- **Open** has 9 stages, **Won** 1, **Lost** 2.
1. Click a status on the left to see its stages on the right.
2. Click **Add** to add a stage to that status.
3. Optional: tick **Enable comments on Status change**.
4. Check **Default Status** (Open) and **Default Stage** (Lead Creation).
5. Click **Save**.
[screenshot: status_config]
(Manual: Section 10.8)
